the development of a low-cost smart thermostat for isothemal DNA amplification in LoC-NAATS, which is a crucial step in the development of a portable, low-cost, and easy-to-use LoC-NAATT.
the development of a low-cost, wireless, and smart thermostat for portable LoC-PCR devices.
the development of a wireless, low-cost smart thermostat for isothermic DNA amplification in LoC cartridges.
